legend: Yes, this is yet another problem about counting binary strings.
You are given a string $$$s$$$ consisting of $$$n$$$ characters; each character is either 1 or 0. Also, you are given an integer $$$k$$$.
You can perform up to $$$k$$$ (possibly zero) operations on string $$$s$$$. Each operation has to be of one of three types:
choose an index $$$i$$$ from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ and replace $$$s_i$$$ with its inverse (that is, if $$$s_i$$$ is 1, replace it with 0, and vice versa);
sort the characters of the string $$$s$$$ in non-descending order (assuming that 1 is greater than 0);
sort the characters of the string $$$s$$$ in non-ascending order (also assuming that 1 is greater than 0).
String $$$t$$$ is reachable if it is possible to obtain it from $$$s$$$ by applying no more than $$$k$$$ operations. You have to calculate the number of reachable strings $$$t$$$.
input: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 150$$$; $$$0 \le k \le n$$$).
The second line contains $$$s$$$ — a string consisting of exactly $$$n$$$ characters. Each character is either 1 or 0.
output: Print one integer — the number of reachable strings. Since the answer can be huge, print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.

legend.ai: 是的，这又是一道关于计数二进制字符串的题目。
给定一个由 $$$n$$$ 个字符组成的字符串 $$$s$$$；每个字符要么是 1，要么是 0。此外，给定一个整数 $$$k$$$。
你可以对字符串 $$$s$$$ 执行至多 $$$k$$$ 次(也可以是零次)操作。每次操作必须属于以下三种类型之一：
选择一个从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$ 的下标 $$$i$$$，并将 $$$s_i$$$ 替换为其相反值(即若 $$$s_i$$$ 为 1，则将其替换为 0，反之亦然)；
将字符串 $$$s$$$ 的字符按非递减顺序排序(假设 1 大于 0)；
将字符串 $$$s$$$ 中的字符按非升序排序(并规定 1 大于 0)。
如果可以从 $$$s$$$ 出发，经过不超过 $$$k$$$ 次操作得到字符串 $$$t$$$，则称该字符串是可达的。你需要计算可达字符串 $$$t$$$ 的数量。

input.ai: 第二行包含 $$$s$$$ —— 一个恰好由 $$$n$$$ 个字符组成的字符串。每个字符都是 1 或 0。

output.ai: 输出一个整数——可达字符串的数量。由于答案可能很大，请输出答案对 $$$998244353$$$ 取模的结果。
